pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha in His Genin Outfit Holding a Kunai at the Hidden Leaf Gates Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Sasuke Uchiha in his genin outfit holding a kunai at the Hidden Leaf gates, standing beneath the large village emblem. His high collar, forehead protector, arm coverings, and leg wraps supply distinct costume sections. The open gate panels and rounded buildings create a detailed backdrop.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Sharingan Portrait with the Uchiha Fan Crest Behind Him Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha's Sharingan portrait fills this printable coloring page, with the large Uchiha fan crest rising behind his spiked hair and high open collar. Small circular eye markings and a serious expression define the face. Broad hair sections, clean collar panels, and the simple emblem leave substantial open coloring areas.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Forming Chidori During Mountain Training with Kakashi Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sasuke Uchiha forming Chidori during mountain training with Kakashi, crouching low as branching lightning surrounds his hand near the ground. Kakashi watches with folded arms, wearing his mask and pocketed vest. Jagged peaks, bushes, and scattered boulders complete the outdoor training scene.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Drawing His Kusanagi Sword in His Shippuden Rope-belt Outfit Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha draws his Kusanagi sword in this printable coloring page, wearing his Shippuden rope-belt outfit and holding the scabbard across his body. The thick braided knot, open collar, wrist coverings, and leg wraps define his costume. A plain background keeps attention on the full-length figure and outlined blade.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Wearing His Akatsuki Cloak with Its Cloud Emblems Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Sasuke Uchiha wearing his Akatsuki cloak with its cloud emblems, standing with the long garment open over his rope-belt outfit. Large curled motifs decorate the sleeves and lower panels. His spiked hair, open collar, wrapped shins, and sandals add smaller details against the blank background.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Unleashing Amaterasu with His Mangekyo Sharingan Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha unleashes Amaterasu with his Mangekyo Sharingan in this printable coloring page, thrusting one fist forward while large outlined flames rise around him. His sword angles behind the thick braided belt. Intricate eye patterns, layered clothing folds, and curling flame tips create detailed sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Protected By His Susanoo Ribcage at the Five Kage Summit Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sasuke Uchiha protected by his Susanoo ribcage at the Five Kage Summit, standing within a towering skeletal chakra figure. Curved ribs extend around him beneath a horned skull. Spiraled joints, outlined flames, stone columns, and tiled flooring add detailed sections around his smaller figure.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Aiming a Chakra Arrow with His Armored Susanoo Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha aims a chakra arrow with his armored Susanoo in this printable coloring page, appearing inside the giant figure's chest beneath its pointed helmet. The Susanoo draws a long bow across layered armor panels. Angular shoulder plates, segmented limbs, and curling flames fill the surrounding coloring sheet.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Inside His Winged Perfect Susanoo Holding a Chakra Sword Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Sasuke Uchiha inside his winged Perfect Susanoo, with his face framed above the giant warrior's chest and lowered chakra sword. Repeated feather-like wing panels stretch down both sides. Pointed armor, shoulder plates, gauntlets, and flame outlines around the blade provide many separate coloring sections.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Directing Kirin Lightning From Storm Clouds Above the Uchiha Hideout Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha directs Kirin lightning from storm clouds above the Uchiha hideout in this printable coloring page, lifting one hand toward a huge dragon-shaped bolt. Branching lightning surrounds its open jaws and pointed mane. Below, Sasuke stands on rubble near a roofed building bearing the Uchiha fan emblem.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha with His Curse Mark Spreading Across His Face in the Forest of Death Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sasuke Uchiha with his Curse Mark spreading across his face in the Forest of Death, standing between enormous tree trunks. The outlined markings extend down his neck above a high collar. Wrapped forearms and shins, a strapped pouch, and textured bark supply smaller details.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha in Curse Mark Stage Two with His Hand-shaped Wings Spread Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha appears in Curse Mark Stage Two with his hand-shaped wings spread in this printable coloring page, holding both clawed hands out beside him. Long pointed wing fingers surround circular palm markings behind his shoulders. Facial patterns, a braided waist knot, and torn trousers add further outlined detail.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Releasing Chidori Stream Around Him in Orochimaru's Hideout Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Sasuke Uchiha releasing Chidori Stream around him in Orochimaru's hideout, extending an open hand amid long branching lightning bolts. His thick rope belt and sheathed sword cross the figure. Cylindrical columns, wall cracks, and tiled floor sections establish the surrounding chamber on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Channeling Chidori Through His Kusanagi Sword Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha channels Chidori through his Kusanagi sword in this printable coloring page, holding the long blade diagonally while lightning branches from its edges. His free hand curls beside his open-collared shirt. The braided rope belt, layered waist panels, and wrapped shins contrast with the otherwise blank background.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Opening a Rinnegan Portal in His Adult Boruto Cloak Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows adult Sasuke Uchiha opening a Rinnegan portal in his Boruto cloak, stretching one palm toward a tall oval opening. Concentric curves and jagged fragments surround the portal beside his billowing cape. A clasped collar, waist belt, wrapped lower legs, and broken ground complete the figure.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Summoning Aoda on the Fourth Great Ninja War Battlefield Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha summons Aoda on the Fourth Great Ninja War battlefield in this printable coloring page, standing before the enormous snake with one hand extended. Aoda coils behind him with open jaws, long fangs, and a forked tongue. Repeating scales, curling smoke, and jagged rocks create many outlined sections.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Riding His Summoned Hawk Above the Samurai Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Sasuke Uchiha riding his summoned hawk above the Samurai Bridge, sitting across the bird's back as its wings spread upward. Layered feathers, hooked talons, and a curved beak dominate the airborne figure. A long bridge and steep river gorge appear far below on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha as a Child Practicing Shuriken Throws with Itachi Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha practices shuriken throws as a child with Itachi in this printable coloring page, extending one arm toward a target marked on a tree. Itachi stands behind him holding another throwing star. Embedded shuriken, circular target rings, Leaf forehead protector details, and grass patches define the training scene.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Learning the Fireball Jutsu Beside Fugaku at the Lake Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha learns the Fireball Jutsu beside Fugaku at the lake in this printable coloring page, forming a hand sign as flames leave his mouth. Fugaku watches with folded arms behind him. Their Uchiha sleeve crests, shoreline rocks, water ripples, and distant hills add clearly separated sections to the scene.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Receiving Itachi's Forehead Poke as a Little Boy Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sasuke Uchiha receiving Itachi's forehead poke as a little boy, smiling with closed eyes while his brother crouches beside him. Itachi touches his forehead with two fingers beneath a Leaf headband. Long cloak sleeves, tied hair, shin wraps, and small grass tufts complete the drawing.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Taking Team 7's First Photograph with Naruto Sakura and Kakashi Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha takes Team 7's first photograph with Naruto, Sakura, and Kakashi in this printable coloring page, holding a compact camera ahead of the group. His teammates crowd behind him with peace signs and smiling expressions. Headbands, pouches, wrapped legs, and clothing folds provide the coloring sheet's smaller sections.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Attempting to Take Kakashi's Bells at the Training Ground Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Sasuke Uchiha attempting to take Kakashi's bells at the training ground, lunging toward the two bells hanging from Kakashi's waist. Kakashi turns away with one leg forward and his mask covering his face. Tall trees, shrubs, and grass frame their contrasting poses.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Practicing Chakra Tree Climbing in the Land of Waves Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha practices chakra tree climbing in the Land of Waves in this printable coloring page, gripping a large trunk while both sandals press against its bark. His bent knees, thigh pouch, and trailing headband ends emphasize the side-view pose. Branches and leafy crowns fill the forest below.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Throwing a Demon Wind Shuriken to Rescue Kakashi From Zabuza Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sasuke Uchiha throwing a Demon Wind Shuriken to rescue Kakashi from Zabuza, reaching forward as the large curved blades spin away. Kakashi appears trapped inside a rounded water prison behind him. Zabuza's broad sword, water droplets, and surrounding ripples reinforce the riverside battle scene.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Facing Haku Inside the Crystal Ice Mirrors Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha faces Haku inside the Crystal Ice Mirrors in this printable coloring page, standing with his kunai lowered between tall, pointed reflective panels. Haku holds a patterned mask near the face beneath tied hair. Sasuke's back crest, the faceted mirror borders, and floor lines supply distinct outlined details.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Preparing to Spar with Rock Lee Before the Chunin Exams Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Sasuke Uchiha preparing to spar with Rock Lee before the Chunin Exams, facing him with bent knees and raised hands. Rock Lee wears bandaged forearms, a high collar, and ribbed leg warmers. Their sandal straps and outfit seams add detail against the broad practice floor.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Performing the Lion's Barrage Against Yoroi in the Chunin Exam Arena Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha performs the Lion's Barrage against Yoroi in the Chunin Exam arena in this printable coloring page, descending with one foot extended above his opponent. Yoroi leans backward with an open hand raised. The visible sandal sole, headbands, face covering, and curved arena wall provide varied enclosed details.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Using Chidori Against Gaara's Sand Shield in the Chunin Exam Arena Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sasuke Uchiha using Chidori against Gaara's sand shield in the Chunin Exam arena, thrusting lightning into a sweeping barrier. Gaara braces behind the curved sand form with his large gourd strapped on. Flying particles, branching bolts, scattered stones, and floor cracks emphasize the clash.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Confronting Orochimaru Among the Giant Trees of the Forest of Death Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha confronts Orochimaru among the giant trees of the Forest of Death in this printable coloring page, looking upward with a kunai beside his leg. Orochimaru's long hair, wide sleeves, and oversized rope belt distinguish the taller figure. Broad trunks, exposed roots, and leaf clusters surround their face-to-face pose.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Leaving the Hidden Leaf Village Under a Crescent Moon Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Sasuke Uchiha leaving the Hidden Leaf Village under a crescent moon, walking forward while gripping the strap of his shoulder pack. His high collar, thigh pouch, and shin wraps mark the full-length figure. Open gate panels and clustered village roofs recede behind him.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Facing Naruto on the Statues Above the Valley of the End Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sasuke Uchiha facing Naruto on the statues above the Valley of the End, with each ninja standing on a different stone head. Huge armored statue faces dominate the foreground. The central waterfall, river gorge, layered cliffs, and distant hills create a deep landscape beneath the two figures.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Confronting Orochimaru with His Sword in the Underground Hideout Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha confronts Orochimaru with his sword in the underground hideout in this printable coloring page, holding the blade diagonally between the two figures. Orochimaru raises one fist beside his long sleeve. Their large rope belts, open collars, cracked walls, stone steps, and column separate the chamber into outlined sections.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Leading Team Hebi with Suigetsu Karin and Jugo Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Sasuke Uchiha leading Team Hebi with Suigetsu, Karin, and Jugo, arranged together in a full-length four-character portrait against a plain background. Sasuke holds a lowered sword in front. Karin's glasses, Suigetsu's large back-mounted weapon, Jugo's torn sleeves, and their varied waist fastenings distinguish the group.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Evading Deidara's Clay Dragon Above a Rocky Battlefield Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha evades Deidara's clay dragon above a rocky battlefield in this printable coloring page, crouching low beside an explosion as the winged creature descends. Deidara rides behind its open, pointed jaws. Segmented wings, a long tail, flying fragments, and jagged rock formations surround Sasuke's extended hand and sheathed sword.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Facing Itachi Across the Uchiha Hideout Throne Room Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Sasuke Uchiha facing Itachi across the Uchiha hideout throne room, seen from behind with his sword strapped beside his rope belt. Itachi stands near the steps in a cloud-patterned cloak. A tall throne, matching fan emblems, wall panels, and broad floor tiles establish the chamber.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Clashing Swords with Killer Bee Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha clashes swords with Killer Bee in this printable coloring page, bracing his blade against the other ninja's weapon above their bent-knee stances. Short impact lines mark the crossing swords. Killer Bee's headband, glasses, scarf, heavy wrist guards, and leg armor contrast with Sasuke's braided rope belt.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Facing the Raikage Among the Five Kage Summit Pillars Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sasuke Uchiha facing the Raikage among the Five Kage Summit pillars, holding his sword downward opposite the larger, muscular ninja. Lightning outlines surround the Raikage's shoulders and arms. Cracked columns, heavy wrist guards, torn clothing edges, and scattered masonry provide detailed sections around the pair.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Confronting Danzo on the Samurai Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha confronts Danzo on the Samurai Bridge in this printable coloring page, standing with his sword lowered across the foreground beside Danzo's long robe. Bandages cover Danzo's forehead and one arm. Sasuke's braided waist knot, the repeated bridge rails, and steep rocky cliffs add distinct shapes behind them.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Fighting Alongside Reanimated Itachi Against Kabuto in the Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Sasuke Uchiha fighting alongside reanimated Itachi against Kabuto in the cave, with the brothers standing back to back beneath Kabuto's outstretched hands. Coiling snakes rise behind the hooded opponent. Itachi's cloud cloak, Sasuke's drawn sword, stalactites, and fractured cave walls create dense outlined details.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Questioning the Four Reanimated Hokage in the Uchiha Shrine Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha questions the four reanimated Hokage in the Uchiha shrine in this printable coloring page, standing before their raised platform with his back visible. Two Hokage sit while two stand behind them. Armor plates, a broad hat, a flame-edged cloak, and the large fan emblem distinguish the shrine scene.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Reuniting with Naruto and Sakura on the Fourth Great Ninja War Battlefield Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sasuke Uchiha reuniting with Naruto and Sakura on the Fourth Great Ninja War battlefield, standing together as Naruto embraces both teammates' shoulders. Sakura holds one fist near her chest. Their equipment pouches, forehead protectors, wrapped shins, and the broken posts behind them add scene details.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Combining His Susanoo Armor with Naruto's Kurama Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha combines his Susanoo armor with Naruto's Kurama in this printable coloring page, standing beside Naruto before the towering armored fox with spreading tails. Layered shoulder plates, circular joints, pointed head armor, and large claws dominate the creature. Its bared teeth and sweeping tail outlines add intricate curved sections.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha and Naruto Using Their Sealing Marks Against Kaguya Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sasuke Uchiha and Naruto using their sealing marks against Kaguya, reaching toward her flowing robe with symbols visible on their palms. Kaguya spreads her arms beneath long horns and cascading hair. Outlined chakra flames, circular clothing motifs, and rocky ground surround the three figures.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Battling Naruto's Kurama with Perfect Susanoo at the Valley of the End Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha battles Naruto's Kurama with Perfect Susanoo at the Valley of the End in this printable coloring page, standing below the two towering chakra figures. The winged armored warrior points its sword toward the fox's open jaws. Broad tails, segmented armor, cliff statues, and a waterfall fill the scene.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Accepting His Forehead Protector From Naruto After Their Final Battle Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Sasuke Uchiha accepting his forehead protector from Naruto after their final battle, with Naruto offering the headband across the space between them. Sasuke extends an open palm beneath his long cloak. The hanging headband ties, wrapped shins, distant hills, and cracked ground supply outlined details.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Traveling in His the Last Outfit with a Head Wrap and Cloak Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha travels in his outfit from The Last in this printable coloring page, wearing a head wrap and long cloak while walking along a rocky path. A layered scarf encircles his neck above the broad cape folds. Wrapped forearms, open-toed sandals, bushes, and distant peaks define the mountain setting.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Training Boruto with Shuriken at the Practice Ground Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sasuke Uchiha training Boruto with shuriken at the practice ground, pointing toward the tree targets as Boruto extends his throwing arm. A star-shaped weapon flies toward the nearest target. Repeating concentric rings, Boruto's jacket seams, Sasuke's cloak, and grass patches add distinct coloring sections.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Coaching Sarada's Sharingan Training in the Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Sasuke Uchiha coaches Sarada's Sharingan training in the forest in this printable coloring page, kneeling behind her as she holds a kunai and forms a hand sign. Sarada wears glasses and a Leaf headband. A large Sharingan diagram floats above them, while broad trunks and grass frame their low stances.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha Standing with Sakura and Sarada Outside the Uchiha Family Home Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Sasuke Uchiha standing with Sakura and Sarada outside the Uchiha family home, with Sarada centered before the wooden entrance. Sakura rests a hand on her daughter's shoulder beneath the large fan emblem. Roof tiles, steps, shrubs, glasses, and clothing fastenings provide varied details.

pages.title: Sasuke Uchiha in Chibi Form Eating an Onigiri Rice Ball on a Village Bench Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Sasuke Uchiha eats an onigiri rice ball on a village bench in this printable coloring page, holding the snack close to his mouth with both hands. His oversized head, spiked hair, and Leaf forehead protector dominate the small figure. Bench slats, bushes, and a round village tower complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Naruto Sasuke Exploring in Academy Courtyard Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Naruto and Sasuke exploring the Academy courtyard, walking side by side on a stone path beside a traditional tiled-roof building. Naruto grips the strap of his pack while Sasuke keeps his arms lowered. A bench, lantern, fence, and drifting leaves fill the surrounding courtyard.

pages.title: Naruto Sasuke Posing in Abandoned Temple Coloring Page
pages.description: Naruto and Sasuke pose in an abandoned temple in this printable coloring page, standing between worn wooden columns before a cracked ceremonial gate and stone steps. Naruto places his hands on his hips while Sasuke holds his sword diagonally. Broken boards, rubble, and a stone lantern add details around them.

pages.title: Naruto Sasuke Waving in Hidden Mist Village Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Naruto and Sasuke waving in the Hidden Mist Village, smiling with one open hand raised each beside their Leaf forehead protectors. Cloud-like mist curls around the nearby roofs and rocky spires. Their pouches, jacket seams, shin wraps, and the winding path supply smaller outlined sections.

pages.title: Naruto Sasuke Posing in Mountain Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: Naruto and Sasuke pose in a mountain valley in this printable coloring page, with Naruto's hands on his hips and Sasuke's arms folded across his chest. Both wear Leaf forehead protectors and strapped equipment pouches. A curving stream, pine trees, angular cliffs, and distant peaks extend behind the pair.

pages.title: Naruto Sasuke Exploring on Mountain Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Naruto and Sasuke exploring a mountain trail, walking side by side with shoulder packs beneath their Leaf forehead protectors. Naruto's open jacket reveals a mesh layer while Sasuke wears a high collar. A winding path, scattered stones, pine trees, and snow-lined peaks surround the pair.

pages.title: Naruto Sasuke Waving in Sand Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Naruto and Sasuke wave in the Sand Village in this printable coloring page, standing before rounded buildings and steep cliffs with one hand raised each. Naruto smiles with closed eyes beside Sasuke's high-collared shirt. Their pouches, shin wraps, sandal straps, and the irregular ground provide smaller outlined details.

pages.title: Naruto Sasuke Waving on Floating Island Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Naruto and Sasuke waving on a floating island, with small clouds surrounding the pointed rocky platform beneath their feet. Sparse grass, pebbles, and dangling roots mark the island. A crescent moon and tiny stars sit above the two figures against the broad open sky.

pages.title: Naruto Sasuke Posing in Secret Base Coloring Page
pages.description: Naruto and Sasuke pose in a secret base in this printable coloring page, standing between brick walls and rough rock with a torch behind them. Naruto raises a peace sign while Sasuke stands beside his sheathed sword. A shelf of scrolls, timber support, and cracked masonry fill the room.

pages.title: Naruto Sasuke Running in Ninja Hideout Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Naruto and Sasuke running in a ninja hideout, leaning forward with bent arms as they move through a narrow stone tunnel. Their headband ties and lifted feet emphasize the motion. Wall torches, timber braces, steps, and a distant Leaf-marked door add setting details.

pages.title: Naruto Sasuke Pointing in Samurai Fortress Coloring Page
pages.description: Naruto and Sasuke point inside a samurai fortress in this printable coloring page, standing on a wooden balcony beside sliding doors and an open courtyard view. Naruto points upward while Sasuke extends an arm across his body. Planked flooring, roof tiles, beams, and crenellated walls create broad architectural sections.
